title: Text: 6166487835 ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Absolutely! That sounds great. And I really do like the league. I think my only issue is with the CBS platform. I feel like it’s just a little difficult to navigate where you want to go when you want
searchText: absolutely! that sounds great. and i really do like the league. i think my only issue is with the cbs platform. i feel like it’s just a little difficult to navigate where you want to go when you want to look at certain stats from a certain day. but they’re very little issues and cbs does have some cool features i’ve been playing around with so you’ll get no complaints from me. i really like the scoring, but again i’m not a fan of how the hits and +/- aren’t in real time. so if you’re in a close matchup you never really know what the score is going to be until they decide to apply those stats unless you go in and look at every players stat line manually 6166487835
